title: Cheese and Pesto Burekas
subtitle: with a sour cream pastry
description: Burekas-style pastry strips filled with feta, cream cheese, kashkaval and pesto, easy to shape and simple to break apart after baking.

steps.text: Mix the flour, cold cubed butter, baking powder and salt in a mixer with the paddle attachment until crumbly. Add the sour cream and mix just until combined. Flatten into a disc, wrap in cling film and refrigerate for at least 5 hours (overnight is best).
Crumble the feta and grate the kashkaval. Mix all the filling ingredients (feta, cream cheese, kashkaval, black pepper, nutmeg and pesto) until smooth and even.
Roll out the dough and cut it into six 14 x 15 cm rectangles.

Spread about three tablespoons of filling along one long side of a rectangle. Fold the dough over lengthwise so the clean half covers the filling, and press to seal. Make 3-4 deep cuts across the width without cutting all the way through, so the pastry breaks easily into pieces after baking. Repeat with the remaining rectangles.
Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and bake for 10-15 minutes until nicely golden.
